verseText: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
meaning: God is the maker of everything. Before anything else existed, God was already there, and he created the heavens and the earth.

recall.question: Who created the heavens and the earth?

meaning.question: Before anything else existed, God was already there. What does this verse teach us about Him?

application.prompt: Think about some of the amazing things God made—the stars, the oceans, the animals, and even you! The next time you see something beautiful in creation, remember that God designed it and give him praise!
